steps.label: At Rest
steps.sub: Files & backups, locked w/o the key

code:
Master Key -> protects Certificate
Certificate -> protects Database Encryption Key
Database Encryption Key -> encrypts the data pages
caption: Back up the certificate — lose it and the database is unreadable, forever.

code:
UPDATE dbo.Customers
SET SSN_Encrypted = ENCRYPTBYKEY(KEY_GUID('SSN_Key'), SSN)
WHERE CustomerId = 1001;

-- DECRYPTBYKEY reverses it, with the key open
caption: Genuinely reversible — unlike a token, the ciphertext encodes the value.
